WAR16154.Chinese:
1203 模組檢查不符（WAR16154）
開機或 EtherCAT 斷線恢復後 10 秒內，D:\HT9045\system\Pci1203Modules.ini 記錄的 IO／馬達模組有缺少、沒有進 OP、站號改變，或多出沒記錄的模組。

處理方式：
1. 先確認安全迴路已復歸（急停放開、安全 PLC 按復歸）。馬達驅動器斷電時，會被判成「缺少」。
2. 檢查 EtherCAT 網路線與模組電源。
3. 是哪一個模組不符，看事件紀錄（HANDLER LOG）裡這一筆警報的內容。
4. 如果是故意更換硬體：刪除 Pci1203Modules.ini 後重新連線，會重新記錄。
WAR16154.English:
PCI-1203 module check mismatch (WAR16154)
Within 10 s of start-up or of an EtherCAT link restore, an IO / motor module listed in D:\HT9045\system\Pci1203Modules.ini is missing, not in OP, at a different station, or a module not in the list was found.

1. Make sure the safety circuit is reset (E-stop released, safety PLC restart pressed): drives without power read as missing.
2. Check the EtherCAT cables and module power.
3. Which module: see this alarm in the event log (HANDLER LOG).
4. After a deliberate hardware change: delete Pci1203Modules.ini and reconnect to record the machine again.

運轉中或馬達動作中，所有 HMI 畫面都關閉了，Handler 已照正常 PAUSE 停下。

(2) 確認機台狀態後再按 START

(1) Open the HMI (browser).
(2) Check the machine, then press START.

WAR16442.Chinese:
Arm Cell 點位移動中止：X／Y 移動時有 Z 離開原點（原點感測器不亮），所有馬達已停止。
(1) 確認該支 Z 軸、吸嘴與移動路徑上有沒有撞到東西
(2) 該軸回原點（HOME）後，再到教導頁 Arm Cell 重新按 GO

Arm Cell move stopped: a Z axis left its origin (home) sensor while X / Y were moving. All motors stopped.
(1) Check that Z axis, its nozzle and the path for a collision.
(2) Home the axis, then press GO on the Teach page Arm Cell tab again.

JAM0109.Chinese:
Input Arm 在Hot Plate上吸取異常
Input Arm Device pick-up error on Hot Plate

(1) 吸取時間太短
      - 按<RETRY>, <PAUSE> 後點選[Speed] 進入 [Input Arm Condition]畫面,
         增加 [Vacuum Check Wait] 欄位裡的數值, 離開畫面後按 <START>繼續生產
(2) 真空sensor (I0510, I0514, I0511, I0515, I0512, I0516, I0513, I0517 ) 未作動.
      - 調整真空sensor
      - 檢查線路
(3) 吸取位置太高
      - 按 <RETRY>, <PAUSE>後點選 [Unit Set] --><Offset> 進入 [Position Offset]畫面,
        按 <Load. Tray>按鈕進入 [Position Offset-Hot Plate]畫面, 減少Loader Tray [Offset]欄位裡的數值,
        離開畫面後按<START>繼續
(4) Device 未被正確放置於加熱盤
      - 若有彎腳情形, 請移除Device後按<SKIP>
      - 若Device完好, 請將Device正確放置於加熱盤後按<RETRY>
(5) 無真空 / 低真空
      - 檢查真真產生器
      - 檢查電磁閥 (O1700, O1710, O1702, O1712, O1704, O1714, O1706, O1716)
      - 檢查管路

Input Arm Device pick-up error on Hot Plate

(1) Pick-up time is too short.
   - "RETRY" then "PAUSE" and increase the value in the [Vacuum Check Wait] box.
     ([Speed] menu -> [Input Arm Condition] dialog).
     Then, close the dialog and "START".
(2) Vacuum sensor (I0510, I0514, I0511, I0515, I0512, I0516, I0513, I0517) doesn't turn ON.
   - Adjust the vacuum sensor.
   - Check the wire.
(3) Pick-up position is too high.
   - "RETRY" then "PAUSE" and reduce the value in the [Loader Tray Offset] box for the Hot Plate 
     ([Unit Set] menu - <Offset> icon - [Position Offset]dialog - <Load. Tray> button - [Position Offset-Hot Plate] dialog).
     Then, close the dialog and "START".
(4) A device isn't put on the Hot Plate correctly.
   - If any pin is bent, remove the device and "SKIP".
   - If the device isn't damaged, put it on the Hot Plate correctly and "RETRY".
(5) There is no (or low) vacuum.
   - Check the function of ejector.
   - Check the function of solenoid valve  (O1700, O1710, O1702, O1712, O1704, O1714, O1706, O1716).
   - Check the pipe.

(1) 吸取時間太短
      - 按<RETRY>, <PAUSE> 後點選[Speed] 進入 [Input Arm Condition]畫面,
         增加 [Vacuum Check Wait] 欄位裡的數值, 離開畫面後按 <START>繼續生產
(2) 真空sensor (I0510, I0514, I0511, I0515, I0512, I0516, I0513, I0517 ) 未作動.
      - 調整真空sensor
      - 檢查線路
(3) 吸取位置太高
      - 按 <RETRY>, <PAUSE>後點選 [Unit Set] --><Offset> 進入 [Position Offset]畫面,
        按 <Load. Tray>按鈕進入 [Position Offset-Hot Plate]畫面, 減少Loader Tray [Offset]欄位裡的數值,
        離開畫面後按<START>繼續
(4) Device 未被正確放置於加熱盤
      - 若有彎腳情形, 請移除Device後按<SKIP>
      - 若Device完好, 請將Device正確放置於加熱盤後按<RETRY>
(5) 無真空 / 低真空
      - 檢查真真產生器
      - 檢查電磁閥 (O1700, O1710, O1702, O1712, O1704, O1714, O1706, O1716)
      - 檢查管路

Input Arm Device pick-up error on Hot Plate

(1) Pick-up time is too short.
   - "RETRY" then "PAUSE" and increase the value in the [Vacuum Check Wait] box.
     ([Speed] menu -> [Input Arm Condition] dialog).
     Then, close the dialog and "START".
(2) Vacuum sensor (I0510, I0514, I0511, I0515, I0512, I0516, I0513, I0517) doesn't turn ON.
   - Adjust the vacuum sensor.
   - Check the wire.
(3) Pick-up position is too high.
   - "RETRY" then "PAUSE" and reduce the value in the [Loader Tray Offset] box for the Hot Plate 
     ([Unit Set] menu - <Offset> icon - [Position Offset]dialog - <Load. Tray> button - [Position Offset-Hot Plate] dialog).
     Then, close the dialog and "START".
(4) A device isn't put on the Hot Plate correctly.
   - If any pin is bent, remove the device and "SKIP".
   - If the device isn't damaged, put it on the Hot Plate correctly and "RETRY".
(5) There is no (or low) vacuum.
   - Check the function of ejector.
   - Check the function of solenoid valve  (O1700, O1710, O1702, O1712, O1704, O1714, O1706, O1716).
   - Check the pipe.

     -檢查電磁閥
     -檢查管路

     -如果有彎腳情形, 請移除產品後, 按<SKIP>
     -如果產品完好, 重新正確放置於pocket後, 按<RETRY>

     the RETRY switch.

Index Arm Vacuum sensor OFF error
   The vacuum sensor doesn't turn OFF though the device is put on.
(1)Vacuum sensor is ON.
   - Adjust the sensor.
(2)Vacuum destroy is too weak.
   - Check the vacuum destroy.
   - Check the function of solenoid valve.
   - Check the wire and pipe.
   - "RETRY" then "PAUSE" and increase the value of the [Counter Air On Time] 
     box (<Speed> icon - [Index unit Condition] dialog).
     Then, close the dialog and "START".

MES0101.Chinese:
Intput Arm device pick-up error on the tray
Input Arm從Tray吸取Device錯誤

(1) Tray內已無Device
      - 按 <TRAY END> , <START>
(2) 吸取時間太短
      - 按<RETRY>, <PAUSE> 後點選[Speed] 進入 [Input Arm Condition]畫面,
         增加 [Vacuum Check Wait] 欄位裡的數值, 離開畫面後按 <START>繼續生產
(3) 真空sensor (I0510, I0514, I0511, I0515, I0512, I0516, I0513, I0517 ) 未作動.
      - 調整真空sensor
      - 檢查線路
(4) 吸取位置太高
      - 按 <RETRY>, <PAUSE>後點選 [Unit Set] --><Offset> 進入 [Position Offset]畫面,
        按 <Load. Tray>按鈕進入 [Position Offset-Loader Tray]畫面, 減少Loader Tray [Offset]欄位裡的數值,
        離開畫面後按<START>繼續
(5) Device未被正確放置於Tray盤
      - 若有彎腳情形, 請移除Device後按<SKIP>
      - 若Device完好, 請將Device正確放置於Tray盤後按<RETRY>
(6) 無真空 / 低真空
      - 檢查真空產生器
      - 檢查電磁閥 (O1700, O1710, O1702, O1712, O1704, O1714, O1706, O1716)
      - 檢查管路

(1)There is no more device on the tray.
   - "TRAY END" then "START".

(2)Pick-up time is too short.
   - "RETRY" then "PAUSE" and increase the value in the [Vacuum Check Wait] box.
     ([Speed] menu - [Input Arm Condition] dialog).
     Then, close the dialog and "START".

(3)Vacuum sensor (I0510, I0514, I0511, I0515, I0512, I0516, I0513, I0517 ) doesn't turn ON.
   - Adjust the vacuum sensor.
   - Check the wire.

(4)Pick-up position is too high.
   - "RETRY" then "PAUSE" and reduce the value in the [Offset] box
     for the Loader Tray ([Unit Set] menu - <Offset> icon - [Position Offset]
     dialog - <Load. Tray> button - [Position Offset-Loader Tray] dialog).
     Then, close the dialog and "START".

(5)A device isn't put on the tray correctly.
   - If any pin is bent, remove the device and "SKIP".
   - If the device isn't damaged, put it on the tray correctly and 
     "RETRY".

(6)There is no (or low) vacuum.
   - Check the function of ejector.
   - Check the function of solenoid valve (O1700, O1710, O1702, O1712, O1704, O1714, O1706, O1716).
   - Check the pipe.

     "RETRY".

   - Check the function of ejector.

MOT1.Chinese:
馬達扭力 & 電源關閉錯誤

(1) 馬達電源未開啟
      - 按下 <POWER ON> 及 <HOME>按鈕
(2) 無熔絲開關未開啟
      - 打開24V 無熔絲開關 
      - 打開教導開關
      - 按 <HOME> 按鈕
(3) X / Y 軸馬達缺乏扭力
      - 請檢查是否有任何障礙物在Handler、滑軌或吸嘴上，請移開障礙物。
      - 按 <HOME>按鈕
(4) Index Z 軸馬達缺乏扭力
      - 重做 Auto Height
      - 增加 [Contact Height Offset] 欄位裡的數值

(1)The Motor Power has been turned OFF
   - Press the POWER ON switch and the HOME switch.
(2)The break been truned OFF
   - Turn on the 24V break.
   - Turn on the Teaching break.
   - Push the HOME switch.
(3)X/Y AXIS Motor Out Of Torque
   - Check if there is any obstacle in handler, guide rails and sucker, remove the obstacle.
   - Push the HOME switch.
(4)INDEX Z AXIS Motor Out Of Torque
   - Do Auto Height again.
   - Increase the value in the [Contact Height Offset] box

WAR0377.Chinese:
Arm 1 compare SLK height over setting value, please check the EP system!
Arm 1比對SLK充氣與不充氣的高度, 發現異常, 請確認相關問題

(1) EP system error, please check the pressure regulating valve, it might malfunction.
(1) EP系統異常, 請確認EP上的調壓閥是否可以正常進氣與出氣

(2) ADAM error, please check if the ADAM can control EP or not.
(2) ADAM故障, 請確認是否可以使用ADAM控制EP

(3) Air tube of index arm might broken.
(3) Index的風管可能破裂

(4) Please check the rubber film in SLK, it might malfunction.
(4) 請檢查浮動頭的膜片是否有破裂

(5) Please check the O-ring of EP between SLK and index arm.
(5) 請檢查SLK與Index Arm之間的O-ring是否有正常安裝

WAR1661.Chinese:
Ion fan 1 alarm
離子風扇1 錯誤警告

[1] Check whether the Ion Fan is running or not
[2] If the "IONLEVEL" indicator is blinking in red, please execute following step
      (1) Press and hold "Stop" for three seconds to stop running.
      (2) Unlock the  lock switch
      (3) Pull out the Electrode Unit
      (4) Clean the electrode needles
      (5) Install the Electrode Unit.
      (6) Lock the lock switch
      (7) Press and hold "Start" for three to start running.
[3] If the "COND" indicator is blinking in red, please execute following step
      (1) Keep the Ion Fan away from conductors or other Ion Fan
      (2) Clean or change the electrode needles (Please refer to the step [2] )
[4]If the three center LEDs of the monitor blink in red, please execute following step
      (1) Please check lock switch
      (2) Please check the front and back panel
      (3) Please press and hold the " < " and " > " for three seconds, the alarm condition will be cancelled.
[5] If the five center LEDs of the monitor blink in red, that might be occur by
      (1) Discharged abnormally
      (2) Electrode unit not attached
      (3) Internal memory value trouble 
      (4) Internal circuit damaged 
      (5) After the alarm condition is cancelled, please turn off the 24V power and re-turn on it.
[6] After the alarm condition is cancelled, please press <RETRY>  --> <Start> on Handler.

[1]檢查該離子風扇是否還在運轉。
[2]如果是"IONLEVEL"在閃爍。
	(1)按下風扇上的 "Stop" 三秒，停止風扇運轉。
	(2)請打開側邊鎖。
	(3)取出探針盤。
	(4)清潔離子探針。
	(5)放回探針盤。
	(6)鎖上側邊鎖。
	(7)按下風扇上的 "Start" 三秒，啟動風扇。
[3]如果是"COND"在閃爍
	(1)讓本「離子風扇」遠離導體或其他「離子風扇」。
	(2)清潔或更換離子探針(步驟請參考[2])。
[4]如果監控器的三個中心 LED 呈紅色閃爍。
	(1)請檢查鎖開關。
	(2)請檢查前後蓋是否安裝正確。
	(3)同時按住離子風扇上的 "<" 與 ">" 鍵三秒可以解除警報。
[5]如果監控器的五個中心 LED 呈紅色閃爍。
	(1)異常放電
	(2)未安裝電極單元
	(3)內建記憶卡的值有問題
	(4)內部電路損壞
	(5)故障排除後，請關閉24V電源重開
[6]排除離子風扇警報後，請按下機台的"Retry"->"Start"。
